stories.name: Basic
stories.description: Basic command menu that allows filtering and selecting options within the same container.

stories.name: InDialog
stories.description: Command menu deployed inside a dialog box, ideal for global search or quick access.

stories.name: Controlled
stories.description: Controlled command menu where the search value is updated from the parent component via state.

stories.name: CustomFilter
stories.description: Command menu with a custom filter that modifies the result matching logic.

stories.name: Groups
stories.description: Command menu that groups options by categories with separators and keyboard shortcuts. The CommandShortcut subcomponent handles visual display only.

stories.name: Keywords
stories.description: Commands using additional keywords for matching and executing actions when selected with onSelect.

stories.name: Loading
stories.description: Handling a loading state within the command menu before showing results.

stories.name: ComboBox
stories.description: Using the command menu as a dropdown ComboBox with Popover for searchable selection.
